description: Set which coins and networks a pay link takes beyond Base USDC (whole-state; {} = Base USDC only; Tron needs a pay_to T-address). Refused (409) when the link's wallet is a smart contract on that network. Requires confirm: true.

confirm.description: Required true: changes which coins and networks buyers can pay this link with.

pay_to.description: Tron only: the T-address that receives USDT on Tron. EVM networks pay the link's own wallet.

tokens.description: Coins to take on this network. An empty list turns the network off.

networks.description: WHOLE-STATE replace of the link's networks beyond Base USDC, keyed by network (ethereum, bnb, monad, tron; see xenarch_list_networks). Example: {"ethereum": {"tokens": ["USDC", "USDT"]}, "tron": {"tokens": ["USDT"], "pay_to": "T..."}}. {} goes back to Base USDC only. Base USDC is always on and can't be turned off. Read the current setting with xenarch_get_link_networks first so you don't drop a network.

name: xenarch_set_link_networks
